question: For any three sets $P,Q$ and $R$, $s$ is an element of $(P\triangle Q)\triangle R$ if $s$ is in

options.B: at least one of $P,Q$ and $R$, but not in all three of them at the same time
options.D: exactly one of $P,Q$ and $R$ or in all the three of them

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
